findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Staff was observed donning gloves without handwashing. Education was carried out. The behavior was corrected. Ensure that employees are reminded to always wash their hands before donning new gloves in between tasks.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking on the hand sink adjacent the large standing freezer in the back was observed to be coming off. PIC was made aware. Ensure that the sink is caulked to the wall providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) There was no Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) present during today’s inspection. PIC was Made aware. PIC assured inspector that they will proceed with the process of getting a CFPM on site at all times during operation. Ensure that there is at least one CFPM present in the facility during operation at all times. 

 Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11(A) Inspector observed the following food items being stored on the floor during inspection. 
1. Multiple lotus containers in cardboard boxes stored directly on the floor next to the double doors standing milk cooler in the back.
2. Multiple boxes of smoothie mix in cardboard boxes stored on the floor at the entrance of the dry storage area. 

PIC was made aware. PIC told inspector that they are currently overstock at the moment however, they would ensure that the above mentioned food items would be stored properly. Ensure that food items are stored at least 6 inches above the floor to protect them from splash, pest, and other forms of contaminations. 

Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.
